channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sean Rooks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sean Rooks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Sean Rooks
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk Nowitzki on Sean Rooks:

“Sean was always a guy that came in & worked hard. He was great in community for us, and he was a great man.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Sean Rooks, Jun 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Sean Rooks
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk Nowitzki on the late Sean Rooks:

“That hit me, obviously. I just saw him a few months ago. ... Always talked to him. He's a nice, nice man.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Sean Rooks, Jun 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Sean Rooks
item.description:
Knicks coach Jeff Hornacek released a statement on the death of Sean Rooks, whom the Knicks interviewed for a position on the coaching staff.

“We are saddened and shocked by the passing of Sean Rooks, especially since we had just met with him yesterday about the possibilities of joining our coaching staff,”

Jeff Hornacek on Sean Rooks, Jun 8, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.
